text: Separation of Execution, Optimization, and Governance in AI Agent Systems argues that conflating those functions creates self-reinforcing hallucinations, optimization drift, and forensically useless audit trails. This supplies a structural separation mechanism extending Kaal's warning about fragmented internal monitoring without external audit standards. It does not test Kaal's decentralized-governance design or show that separation alone resolves the failures.
